1 TENDER ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: [a] The bidder with past performance of satisfactory execution of contracts to SC Railway/Other Zon al Railways/PUs/Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs for supply of the same / similar items for a quantity of 20 percent or more of tendered quantity against a single contract during last three years prior to, an d excluding tender opening date shall be considered as responsive to SC Railways requirements for placement of bulk and regular order. bidders are requested to submit the past performance report s uch as Copies of R Notes/CRAC/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee etc. along with their off er; failing which offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. SIMILAR ITEM: Any type of Computers [b] In case, the bidder participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as required above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the same OEM. It may so happen t hat the agent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a different Principal/OEM, then it will not be co nsidered as performance. For Authorised dealers, tender specific authorization from OEM has to be u ploaded with bid. 2 3 4 Payment Terms: The standard payment terms subject to recoveries, if any, under the liquidated damages clause and general condition of contract will be as under:- 100% payment will be made after receipt, installation and acceptance of the material by the consign ee. 5 Other conditions: 1. Windows Hardware compatibility certificate for window operating system to ensure the supply har dware is compatible with windows operating system must be submitted along with the Bid. 2. Bidders must clearly indicate the make and model of the offered item, along with the specification s at the time of tender submission, if not offer will not be considered. 3. Warranty period as per OEM warranty for 3 years. 4. Warranty certificate shall be submitted along with the material in the name of SSE/ST/ELS/BZA.

6 Penalty Clause: 1. After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit (or as specified in other terms in contract). 2. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification within the defined time limit, a penalty of 0 .5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the se ller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to r ecover all such shall be charged as penalty or recover all such penalty amount from the Warra nty Performance Security (WPBG) for each week of delay from the seller. 3. Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 5% of the total contract value after which the B uyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the ri sk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cos t of such service /get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cos t of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cost of such s ervice / rectification to the Buyer. 4. Bad performance in supply/warranty obligations etc. in this contract shall be recorded and dul y taken into consideration while taking decision in future tenders issued from Indian Railways. Bad performance shall include, but not limited to, failure to honour timelines/ conditions specif ied in contract, PO cancellation on suppliers account, repeated DP extension, poor warranty/A MC support etc. 7 Consignee Details (For delivery and payment matters): Name: BANDREDDY LAKSHMI PHANIKUMAR Designation: SSE/NS-INDENTS/ ST/ELS/BZA Contact No.9701373332 Office of Electric Loco Shed, Near Milk Factory, Chitti Nagar, Vijayawada. Krishna Dist, Andhra Pradesh PIN 520009 Special Conditions: 1 The bidders must submit a certificate stating that all their statements/documents submitted along wi th the bid are true and factual. The standard format of certificate to be submitted by the bidder is en closed as Annexure-1 (see ATC doc). Non-submission of above certificate (completely filled, signed a nd stamped in given proforma) by the bidder shall result in summary rejection of his/ their bid. 2 Bidder should upload attached specification document in ATC duly signed, stamped and complied in all respects along with the bid. Else, offer shall be summarily rejected. 3 No deviation from the stipulated inspection clause shall be permitted. The inspection shall strictly be carried out by the designated inspection agency as per the prescribed norms.

4 Warranty : Unless otherwise specified in the bid document, attached specifications/terms/scope of supply etc., warranty shall be as per IRS condition of contract. Warranty period of the supplied products from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of good s (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be subm itted by the contractor at the time of delivery of Goods. 5 EMD : Offers submitted without applicable EMD shall be summarily rejected. Railways have the Righ t to forfeit the Earnest Money Deposit if the bidder withdraws or revises his offer within the offer vali dity period. Bank details for payment of EMD: ACCOUNT NUMBER 45206745356 BANK NAME STATE BANK OF INDIA BRANCH NAME SBI CMP CENTER CITY NAME HYDERABAD ADDRESS Aishwaryam, SY No.26, Opp HCU Main Gate, Lingampally Post, Hyederabad, 500019. IFSC CODE SBIN0004266 MICR CODE 400002166 6 PBG : 1. PBG from successful bidder should be received in purchase office within 21 days from the dat e of communication of acceptance of offer with respect to the purchaser. PBG may be submitt ed in the form of FDR/BG etc. 2. If the successful bidder does not deposit the PBG amount within stipulated time, then EMD sh all be forfeited and case will be dealt with as that of withdrawal of offer by the bidder as per e xtant instructions. 3. PBG should remain valid for a minimum period of 6 months, beyond the date of co mpletion of all contractual obligations including warranty period. 4. If PBG is submitted in the form of Bank Guarantee (BG) then it may be ensured that claim pe riod must exceed the BG validity period by atleast 6 months. 5. PBG shall be returned/refunded only after completion of warranty period as specified in contra ct.

7 It may be ensured that, the BGs/FDRs /Guarantee Bonds towards PBG/Performance Guarantee/Warranty Security etc are to be submitted in favour of Sr.DFM /S.Co.R ly/BZA only. Bank Details: State Bank Of India, A/c No: 10464670019, IFSC Code: SBIN0000948, Main Branch, VI JAYAWADA. Address for submission : Sr.DMM Office, DRM Compound, Vijayawada - 520001 8 Bidders may note that Delivery period shall be negotiable, but material is required urgently.
